questions.stem: A calorimetry experiment measures a temperature rise of 7°C when 100 cm³ of solution reacts. Using c = 4.18 J/g/°C, what is Q?
questions.explanation: Using Q = mcΔT: m = 100 g (assuming density of 1 g/cm³), c = 4.18 J/g/°C, ΔT = 7°C. So Q = 100 × 4.18 × 7 = 2926 J. Remember to use the mass of the solution, not the volume directly.
